name: Spectrum Analyzer
short_description: Displays the frequency spectrum of a signal
description: This algorithm implements a simple but useful spectrum analyser.

parameters.name: FFT size
parameters.description: The size of the analysis FFT.

parameters.name: Draw mode
parameters.description: Sets the draw mode – Lines (continuous), Lines (vertical), or Points.

parameters.name: X axis
parameters.description: Sets whether the X axis is linear or logarithmic.

input_ports.name: Left/mono input
input_ports.description: The left or mono input audio bus.

input_ports.name: Right input
input_ports.description: The right input audio bus (simply summed with the left bus, if provided).
